private_key.title: Private Key
private_key.description: RSA private key from the Google service account JSON key file. Required for service accounts

client_email.title: Client Email
client_email.description: Service account email address (e.g. my-app@project-id.iam.gserviceaccount.com). Required for service accounts

subject.title: Subject Email
subject.description: Gmail user to impersonate via domain-wide delegation (e.g. user@yourdomain.com). For service account
